theorem corrected_inventory (z : Counts) (hz : restartX z) (hy : z 1=1) :
    coreMass (update z 10)=80 ∧ fuelMass (update z 10)=1 ∧
    (update z 10) 1=0 ∧ 8≤(update z 10) 0

theorem correction_total (r j g h : ℝ) :
    g*h*(r-j)*(r-j-1)*j+g*h*j*(j-1)*(r-j)=g*h*j*(r-j)*(r-2)

theorem embedded_down_probability (r j g h : ℝ)
    (hg : g≠0) (hh : h≠0) (hj : j≠0) (hrj : r-j≠0) (hr : r-2≠0) :
    (g*h*(r-j)*(r-j-1)*j)/(g*h*j*(r-j)*(r-2))=(r-j-1)/(r-2)
theorem two_fuel_eight_two : fuelValue 10 2 2=7/8
theorem finite_fuel_boundary (r L : ℕ) : fuelValue r L 0=1
theorem repair_exponential_bound : Real.exp (-(56 : ℝ)) ≤ 1/1000000
theorem ten_cycle_budget : (4999/5000 : ℚ)^10 > 998/1000
theorem extra_hazard_budget : (80 : ℚ)/10^9+80^3/10^12 < 1/10^6
theorem quotient_lower (a d : ℕ) : a/d*d≤a

theorem reaction_conserves (z : Counts) (r : Channel) (h : enabled z r) :
    coreMass (update z r)=coreMass z ∧ fuelMass (update z r)=fuelMass z

theorem repair_result (z : Counts) (hx : 2≤z 0) (hy : z 1=1) (hh : z 5=1) :
    update z 10 = ![z 0+1,0,z 2,z 3,z 4,0,z 6+1]

theorem repair_enabled (z : Counts) (hx : 2≤z 0) (hy : z 1=1) (hh : z 5=1) :
    enabled z 10

theorem refill_food_bill (n f p a b : ℕ) (hm : n+f+p=80)
    (hab : a+b=n+f) : (80-a)+(80-b)=80+p

theorem conditional_iteration (p : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0≤q)
    (h0 : p 0=1) (hstep : ∀ n, q*p n≤p (n+1)) (n : ℕ) : q^n≤p n

theorem central_derivative_nonneg (n : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (h0 : 0≤θ) (hhalf : θ≤1/2) :
    0≤(n : ℝ)*((n-1).choose 7 : ℝ)*θ^7*(1-θ)^7*
      ((1-θ)^(n-15)-θ^(n-15))

theorem recovery_partition_product_mono (a b c d : ℝ)
    (ha : 0≤a) (hc : 0≤c) (hab : a≤b) (hcd : c≤d) : a*c≤b*d

theorem partition_is_binomial_expectation (n m : ℕ) :
    jointPartition n m = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n+1),
      (PMF.binomial (1/2) (by norm_num) n (Fin.ofNat (n+1) j)).toReal *
      (if m≤j ∧ m≤n-j then 1 else 0)

theorem complementary_restart (n j : ℕ) (hn : n≤80) (hj : j≤n)
    (ha : 8≤j) (hb : 8≤n-j) :
    restartX ![j,0,80-j,0,0,1,0] ∧
    restartX ![n-j,0,80-(n-j),0,0,1,0]

theorem impossible_below_two_minima (n m : ℕ) (h : n<2*m) :
    jointPartition n m=0
theorem integer_prefix_max (r : ℤ) : 15999*r-199*r^2≤321560
theorem refined_repair_exponential : Real.exp (-(14 : ℝ))≤1/1000000

theorem selection_five_four :
    1-(20 : ℚ)/5000-discardedTail 16=16297339/16384000

theorem selection_four_three :
    1-(20 : ℚ)/5000-discardedTail 15=129773087/131072000

theorem robust_readout (g b mg mb : ℤ)
    (hg : 4≤g) (hb : b≤1)
    (heg : |mg-g|≤1) (heb : |mb-b|≤1) :
    (3 : ℤ) ≤ mg ∧ mb < 3

theorem rate_nonneg (γ β ε : ℝ) (hγ : 0≤γ) (hβ : 0≤β) (hε : 0≤ε)
    (z : Counts) (r : Channel) : 0≤rate γ β ε z r

theorem opposing_majority_vanishes (γ β ε : ℝ) (z : Counts) (hy : z 1≤1) :
    rate γ β ε z 12=0

theorem repair_rate (γ β ε : ℝ) (z : Counts) (hy : z 1=1) (hh : z 5=1) :
    rate γ β ε z 10=γ*(z 0*(z 0-1) : ℕ)
theorem repair_factor_lower (x : ℕ) (hx : 8≤x) : 56≤x*(x-1)

theorem truncated_uniformization_lower {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (P : FiniteKernel α) (t : NNReal) (f : α → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0≤f x)
    (J : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ j, w j≤poissonWeight t j)
    (ha0 : ∀ j x, 0≤a j x) (ha : ∀ j x, a j x≤P.steps j f x) (x : α) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range J, w j*a j x ≤ P.poissonized t f x
